block.raildispatch.physics_cab.tooltip.s: Reads a _Create train schedule_, watches _train signals_ and drives a _physics bogie_.
block.raildispatch.physics_cab.tooltip.b: Executes its entries: _stop_, _wait_, _couple vehicle_, _shunt by address_.
block.raildispatch.physics_cab.tooltip.c: When a signal ahead is red
block.raildispatch.physics_cab.tooltip.b: Brakes to a halt before the signal and requests a _route_ from the dispatch layer.
block.raildispatch.autopilot_console.too: Type a destination and let the vehicle run the _Create track graph_ itself: _switches_ thrown, _signals_ obeyed, speed held by a _PID_ loop.
Enter a station sign, nameplate or vehicle tag and press start.
Publishes _forward_ and _brake_ channels (0-15). It drives away from its screen face (the way the operator faces at it) and has no reverse channel.
block.raildispatch.reverser.tooltip.summ: Steers a physics bogie. Controlled by a _Physics Cab_ or by _redstone_.
block.raildispatch.reverser.tooltip.beha: Steering follows the analogue signal strength.
block.raildispatch.dispatch_center.toolt: Centralised route calculation over the _Create track graph_; drives ground _switches_.
Right-click a rail with the item, then place the block
Selects that track first, exactly like a _Train Signal_. The centre then knows which railway it governs.
Reserves edges per vehicle, locks the switches and releases the route when the vehicle clears it.
block.raildispatch.address_plate.tooltip: Marks the _destination_ of a shunting track (hump yard sorting).
Stores that address as this track's destination code.
block.raildispatch.retarder.tooltip.summ: Brakes a free-rolling wagon passing over it. The _redstone signal level_ (0-15) is the brake force.
block.raildispatch.retarder.tooltip.cond: Right-click a rail with the item, then place the block against it
block.raildispatch.retarder.tooltip.beha: Binds to that rail point like a station or signal. Redstone 0 is off, 15 is full braking; only free-rolling vehicles are braked.
block.raildispatch.smart_retarder.toolti: Keeps a _configured gap_ to the wagon ahead. The following free wagon is braked automatically.
Right-click a rail with the item, then place the block against it
No redstone needed. Gap is set in the config (smartRetarderGap, default 8 blocks).
block.raildispatch.automatic_uncoupler.t: Opens the nearest _Simurail automatic coupler_ when a vehicle passes its point.
Right-click a rail with the item, then place the block against it
Binds to that rail point like a station or signal; a vehicle passing it is uncoupled once.
item.raildispatch.vehicle_tag.tooltip.su: Names a vehicle so schedules can _address it by name_.
item.raildispatch.vehicle_tag.tooltip.co: Right-click a Physics Cab or a physics vehicle
item.raildispatch.vehicle_tag.tooltip.be: Binds the tag (its anvil name) to that vehicle.
Used as the destination of _Couple Vehicle_ and of tag-addressed routing.
item.raildispatch.address_tag.tooltip.su: A wagon's _destination code_ for hump shunting.
item.raildispatch.address_tag.tooltip.be: Writes the address onto that wagon; the hump controller sorts it to the matching plate.
Registers the address of that destination track.
item.raildispatch.vehicle_tag.unbound: Tag "%s" is not bound to any vehicle
